description.en: Prepares the item that pops out of a treasure chest (an "item" object of the field). The chest script calls it, when the command exists, as the chest opens; CMND_SET_POP_ITEM then gives the item and where it appears.

examples.case: A chest opening (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_tbox.nut; the decompiled file shows the existence test as $[stack offset 0]; it is written here with getroottable(), the form ev42019001.nut shows)
